items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: And our daughter Kristen is the most wonderful that ever happened to us.

ctx.x: No I was the luckiest man. She’s the most wonderful thing that ever happened to me. And our daughter Kristen is the most wonderful that ever happened to us. So I’m blessed all the way around, as a musician and as a person, I can’t complain.
So now you’re a free lance musician— © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
